summary.en: India raised its fiscal-year growth forecast while Prime Minister Modi warned that the ideological challenge from Naxals remains, after anti-Naxal gains. In Kashmir, ambulances were stranded and students missed classes during a convoy, and the Mirwaiz called for political engagement and release of political prisoners. In Manipur, large rallies demanded the abrogation of the SoO agreement, and three Kuki-Zo volunteers were killed in a gunfight, with security forces arresting three militants in Imphal. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: India hevet sin vekstprognose for regnskapsåret, mens statsminister Modi advarte om at den ideologiske utfordringen fra naxalene fortsatt består etter anti-naxal-gevinster. I Kashmir ble ambulanser strandet og studenter gikk glipp av undervisning under en konvoi, og Mirwaiz oppfordret til politisk engasjement og løslatelse av politiske fanger. I Manipur krevde store demonstrasjoner opphevelse av SoO-avtalen, og tre Kuki-Zo-frivillige ble drept i en skuddveksling, mens sikkerhetsstyrker arresterte tre militante i Imphal. 437 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
